PRODUCT.STORY_TITLE: Every strand is a seed of memory
PRODUCT.STORY_TEXT: Needle felting rebuilds the likeness of a pet through many thousands of needle passes, worked entirely by hand. Unlike a factory soft toy, each Petmory piece follows the character, the eyes and the particular markings that only someone who lives with them would know.
PRODUCT.NOTE_EYES_TEXT: The eyes are glazed to carry depth, so the mischief or the gentle warmth of your friend comes through.
PRODUCT.NOTE_COAT_TEXT: A maker blends four to eight shades of natural wool to reach a true gradient from the back to the chest.
PRODUCT.PROCESS_TITLE: Four steps from photograph to keepsake
PRODUCT.PROCESS_TEXT: You pick a model and paint it in 3D. The workshop receives a production file with the colour of each zone, six-angle photos and the engraving, then builds the frame and felts the shape. Handwork takes 7 to 14 days depending on size.
PRODUCT.CARE_TEXT: Keep it somewhere dry and out of long direct sunlight, since ultraviolet light fades wool. Brush dust away with a soft brush, or blow it off with a hairdryer on cool. Never wash or wring it. If a strand fluffs up, trim it close with small scissors rather than pulling it.
